lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Thank you for all your help.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Please take this

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: as a token of my gratitude.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I was worried that something may have happened to my grandfather's remains,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: but now that you've confirmed that the ashes are safe,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I can finally sleep in peace.
Actually...

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Yes?
Did you actually see your grandfather get cremated?
Did you confirm that the ashes in this urn were your grandfather's?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: The Central Government handles all cremation procedures.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Unless there are extenuating circumstances, you're not allowed to watch.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Of course not. Why would I?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: That would be... indecent.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Are you saying that

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: you saw something?
There was something that concerned us.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Was there something inside the urn that shouldn't have been there?
It didn't seem to contain human remains.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: How is that possible?!
There are no messages for a while.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Actually, come to think of it...

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: the urn did feel exceptionally light.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I didn't think much of it at the time,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: but it was definitely enough for me to take notice.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I'll be in touch.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Thank you
What are you going to do?
There is no further response.
